posts.name: arc-chichi
posts.caption:
CHI-CHI'S FIRST EGG, a story in 5 parts. She arrived motherless at three weeks old, smaller than the forecast allowed, and spent her first week against a borrowed wing. Months of quiet watching later, a whole nation waited on one small hen. Statement in full: "I did my best." Swipe through all 5. 🥚 Meet the flock at kisi.africa, order farm-fresh eggs at kisi.africa/shop.
